capabilities: generate a markdown file from current bookmarks
compute statistics per bookmark group and type
regenerate the file automatically on a set interval
exclude bookmarks whose notes no longer exist
configure output filename and sidebar icon
extras: The generated file is overwritten on every update and must be treated as read-only; the Bookmarks core plugin must be enabled.
problem: Obsidian bookmarks can only be browsed in the bookmarks panel, with no way to export them as a readable markdown file in the vault.

relations.evidence: The Bookmarks core plugin must be enabled (Settings → Core plugins → Bookmarks).

summary: Bookmark export tool that generates a markdown file listing all Obsidian bookmarks, with statistics per group and per type.
